title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! It's Friday, November 6, 2026.

🌤️ Weather
It's a soggy one. Today is a CBS "First Alert Weather Day."
• Now: mild, in the 60s
• High 67° / low in the 50s to 60s tonight (the overnight low wasn't firmly forecast)
• Rain: about 90% chance, with roughly half an inch in the city. South and east of NYC could see 2–3 inches, so some flooding is possible.
• Saturday: high near 60, 30% chance of showers
👉 Bring a real umbrella and a rain jacket, and wear waterproof shoes. Skip the heavy coat because it's warm.

🗞️ Headlines
• Markets: tech stocks were hit hard overnight. Reports say the Nasdaq fell more than 5% on worries about tighter data-center rules, and the selloff spread to Asia, where South Korea's KOSPI dropped about 8% at the open.
• Iran: Trump says he'll soon decide whether to resume full-scale strikes, keep up economic pressure, or take a deal. Qatar is pushing a proposal, there are reports of tankers on fire in the Strait of Hormuz, and oil is near $100.
• Washington: after the midterms, Democrats are preparing investigations into Trump's family and associates once they take control of Congress early next year.
• NYC: voters approved all five ballot proposals backed by Mayor Mamdani. They speed up outdoor dining, street-safety projects, construction permits and city contracts, and change the rules for the rainy-day fund.
• NYC: a state appeals court sided with the city on Mamdani's tax on luxury second homes (the "pied-à-terre" tax), so the rollout can go ahead. A separate constitutional challenge is still pending.

🚇 Getting around
• Heavy rain can cause flooding at some stations and slow service, so leave extra time and check the MTA app before you head out.
• This weekend (Nov 7–9): planned J and M work in Brooklyn is reportedly one of five weekends of track renewal. Check MTA planned service changes before riding.

🎉 NYC today
• The New York Comedy Festival starts today and runs through Nov 15, with shows all over town.
• Rockefeller Center's Holiday Chalets open today, and the Christmas tree arrives tomorrow (Sat, Nov 7). Holiday season has started.

💡 Nugget
With flooding possible, take 30 seconds to sign up for Notify NYC, the city's free emergency alert service (text, email or app). You'll get flash-flood and transit alerts for your neighborhood on days like today.
